aws.reason: no AWS or GCP account, staging environment or reviewer was available

gcp.reason: no AWS or GCP account, staging environment or reviewer was available

faults.cloud_needs: Kill a task or revision instance and read the platform's own restart and health record.
faults.local_limits: The runner is the supervisor; no orchestrator restarts anything.
faults.summary: SIGKILL the serving process; a supervisor starts a new one. Also kills a state writer at random points.
faults.title: Process kill

faults.cloud_needs: A failing health check and a rolling deployment on ECS and Cloud Run with the load balancer's request log.
faults.local_limits: Processes, not containers; readiness-gated switching is done by the runner, not by ECS or Cloud Run.
faults.summary: A replacement that never becomes ready is not admitted; a ready replacement takes over without dropped requests.
faults.title: Unhealthy instance and rolling restart

faults.cloud_needs: Revoked or wrong workload identity and secret versions on each provider.
faults.local_limits: The credential is the bundle signing key in an environment variable; no IAM, token issuer or secret manager is involved.
faults.summary: The service starts with a key that does not verify its bundle; it stays alive and unready until the key is corrected.
faults.title: Invalid credentials

faults.cloud_needs: A denied bucket policy or key on S3 and GCS and a restore from versioned objects.
faults.local_limits: A local emulator (scmle.deploy.mocks); no IAM, bucket policy, versioning or replication.
faults.summary: The store stops answering; the running service keeps serving; when access returns the bundle is fetched again by digest.
faults.title: Lost object-store access

faults.cloud_needs: An outage or throttling of CloudWatch and Cloud Monitoring.
faults.local_limits: A local metrics sink; not CloudWatch or Cloud Monitoring.
faults.summary: The metrics destination is down; telemetry is spooled and drained when it returns; serving is unaffected.
faults.title: Dependency outage

faults.cloud_needs: A corrupted object in S3 or GCS and an image whose bundle digest differs from the release record.
faults.local_limits: The copy is in a local folder and an emulator.
faults.summary: A modified model file never becomes ready; restoring the bundle from a digest-checked copy recovers.
faults.title: Corrupted bundle

faults.cloud_needs: A client and a model version released on a provider that differ in schema.
faults.local_limits: One local service and one client.
faults.summary: Requests with a schema the service does not serve are refused with a precise status; the service keeps serving; the caller recovers by reading the schema.
faults.title: Incompatible schema

faults.cloud_needs: The same on ECS and Cloud Run with their real revisions and traffic shares.
faults.local_limits: Revisions are local processes behind a local control plane that implements the same interface as the ECS and Cloud Run adapters.
faults.summary: A release that serves wrong answers is detected from delayed labels and rolled back to the previous revision; a release that never becomes ready is not promoted and the previous revision is restored.
faults.title: Bad release

faults.cloud_needs: Step Functions and Cloud Workflows executions with their own retry and state.
faults.local_limits: The local executor and a local state directory.
faults.summary: A workflow run is killed mid-step; after the lease expires it continues; finished steps are not repeated.
faults.title: Job interruption with persistent state

faults.cloud_needs: The ledger on the provider's durable storage across a task replacement.
faults.local_limits: Process kill only; no machine crash, disk full or torn page.
faults.summary: The ledger writer is killed; the chain verifies after restart and continues without a gap.
faults.title: Audit-log continuity

faults.cloud_needs: A rotation in Secrets Manager and Secret Manager with the workload picking up the new version.
faults.local_limits: A rotated environment variable; no secret manager versions.
faults.summary: The signing key is rotated; a service with the old key cannot verify the new bundle and recovers once given the new key.
faults.title: Secret rotation

faults.cloud_needs: A previous ECS task definition revision or Cloud Run revision with the traffic split read back from the platform.
faults.local_limits: The registry logic is exercised in bad_release against local processes; no managed revision exists locally.
faults.summary: Traffic returns to the previous revision of the managed service and the registry follows only after the platform confirms.
faults.title: Rollback to a managed revision

faults.cloud_needs: Two zones or regions per provider and a deliberate failover.
faults.summary: A zone or region of the provider is unavailable.
faults.title: Zone or region loss

objectives.scope: the serving process; stateless, so recovery is a restart to ready
reload and chain verification after the writer is killed; a machine crash or power loss is not covered (no fsync is claimed)
atomic replacement of a state file with its writer killed
the local object-store emulator, from access restored to a verified bundle serving; not S3 or GCS

objectives.rpo_unit: none: secrets are held outside this system
objectives.scope: from detection of a credential mismatch to ready under the corrected or rotated key; a local environment variable, not a secret manager
from the destination returning to the spool drained; delivery is at least once, so duplicates are possible
a workflow run killed mid-step and continued from its persisted state, including the wait for the lease to expire

measurements.method: SIGKILL to the first 200 from /predict of the restarted process, 3 trials, maximum; RPO is answers that differ from before the kill. time.monotonic() in the runner

10 trials: a child rewrites a state file atomically in a loop and prints each acknowledged counter; SIGKILL at a random point; the file is read back and its counter must not be below the last acknowledged one

unready_replacement.reason: artifact: checksum mismatch: pipeline.joblib was modified or corrupted

measurements.method: a client sends one /predict every 50 ms to the instance the runner has declared current; RTO is the longest run of failures, RPO is failed requests; the runner stands in for the orchestrator: it switches only after /readyz is 200

with_wrong_key.reason: artifact: bundle signature is invalid: the bundle was modified or signed with a different key

measurements.method: from the service reporting the credential failure to the first 200 from /predict under the corrected key (restart included). time.monotonic() in the runner
measurements.rpo_unit: none: secrets are held outside this system

measurements.method: from the emulator being started again on the same port and root to a refetched, digest-verified bundle serving; RPO is uploaded objects missing from the root afterwards. time.monotonic() in the runner
50 samples spooled while the sink was down, the spool object recreated (a restart), the sink started, then flushed; RTO is the flush time, RPO is sample names absent from the sink

tampered_verdict.reason: artifact: checksum mismatch: pipeline.joblib was modified or corrupted

measurements.method: from the service reporting the tampered bundle to the first 200 after restoring a copy whose digest equals the recorded one. time.monotonic() in the runner

classification.response: inspect the upstream feed and the request schema; do not retrain on this data

measurements.method: from the first refused request to a 200 after the client read /schema and sent its digest; the service itself was never down. time.monotonic() in the runner

reasons: the platform did not confirm: the platform does not report the service ready

measurements.method: from the labelled-outcome window classifying the release as model performance to the platform confirming the previous revision with all traffic (rollback and read-back). Detection delay is reported separately. time.monotonic() in the runner
a child runs a 3-step workflow and SIGKILLs itself in step 2; after the 1 s lease a second process starts the same trigger; RTO includes the lease wait; RPO counts completed steps run again or lost

5 trials: a child appends audit rows and prints each acknowledged one; SIGKILL at a random point; the ledger is reopened (chain verified) and must hold at least every acknowledged row; then it is extended and verified again. Machine crash and power loss are not covered.

stale_key_verdict.reason: artifact: bundle signature is invalid: the bundle was modified or signed with a different key

measurements.method: from the stale key being refused to the first 200 under the rotated key with the re-signed bundle. time.monotonic() in the runner
measurements.rpo_unit: none: secrets are held outside this system
